verdict.rationale: The Wyoming Secretary of State runs authenticated online filing accounts that hold user data, so a policy or control preventing that data from being used to train AI models is a fair privacy question. However, the evidence pack contains nothing about AI-training use, opt-outs, or any data-use policy. The docs cover only business filings, annual reports, registered agents and public search. The probes found no machine-readable policy surface: robots.txt returns HTML and llms.txt returns 404.
